free_tier_limits.correction: A two-week free trial allows up to 60 hits per minute. Afterward, non-paid access is limited to 5 hits per minute. Endpoint-specific travel-time and level-of-detail limits also apply.

rate_limits.correction: Rate limits are published and plan-dependent: 60 hits per minute during the two-week trial, 5 hits per minute afterward, and custom or no concurrency limits for paid licences.

notes: Official status and update pages show API v4 operational with no shutdown or migration warning. The material error is the claim that limits are unknown or unpublished; TravelTime documents trial, post-trial, endpoint, and plan-specific limits. CORS remains undocumented in the official sources located.
